question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

claims.text: Raymond James Financial: Trade press reports (2026-10-29) that the firm reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year. Why it might matter: the same passage states this was a record quarter-end figure for the firm.
